title: JevGPT: Thinking Fast and Slow in Autonomous Research
abstract: arXiv:2610.18272v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autonomous research agents must acquire and reason over evidence within a limited budget. Yet relevant sources can remain uninspected or unused, leaving a gap between retrieval coverage and the evidence that informs research. The challenge is to align fast local judgments with changing evidence needs and feed their findings back into research decisions. We introduce JevGPT, a dual-system architecture for autonomous research that couples fast evidence processing with deliberative research planning. System Two sets evidence objectives and integrates findings, while System One locates support, assesses relevance, and guides further inspection. Independent source judgments run in parallel; selected original passages inform the next research step. Experiments on fixed-corpus question answering and document ranking show that JevGPT achieves leading task performance, with faster completion and lower cost than comparably effective research age

translated_title: JevGPT：自主研究中的快与慢思考
translated_abstract: 自主研究智能体必须在有限的预算内获取证据并进行推理。然而，相关资料源可能未被检查或未被利用，导致检索覆盖范围与真正指导研究的证据之间存在差距。挑战在于如何将快速的局部判断与不断变化的证据需求保持一致，并将其发现反馈到研究决策中。我们提出了JevGPT，一种用于自主研究的双系统架构，它将快速证据处理与深思熟虑的研究规划相结合。系统二负责设定证据目标并整合研究发现，而系统一则负责定位支持材料、评估相关性并引导进一步的查阅。独立的资料源判断并行运行；被选中的原始文段为下一步研究提供依据。在固定语料库问答和文档排序实验中，JevGPT取得了领先的任务性能，与同等有效的研究智能体相比，完成速度更快且成本更低。
tldr: JevGPT提出了一种受“快与慢”思维启发的双系统自主研究架构，系统二负责制定证据目标并整合发现，系统一则快速并行地定位和评估证据来源，在问答与文档排序任务上实现了领先的性能，同时速度更快、成本更低。
en_tdlr: JevGPT introduces a dual-system autonomous research architecture inspired by fast-and-slow thinking, where System Two sets evidence objectives and integrates findings while System One rapidly locates and evaluates sources in parallel, achieving leading task performance with faster completion and lower cost.
